others.route: Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao

note: Laos: an entity using foreign labour imported under its approved quota needs the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare's permit for each foreign worker (Skill Development and Employment Department; datasheet last modified 9 January 2018). No performers' exemption was found, so no days.

sources.title: Lao Trade Portal, Datasheet: Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao (MoLSW-SDED-7, 9 January 2018)
sources.said: Name of formality         Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao ... Any legal entity that intends to utilise those foreign labour that they have ... imported according to the approved quota.
